data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate released GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2017: GBP 39.4m), arising predominantly from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions (2017: primarily from the Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1084 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 35.2 million in 2018, primarily driven by favourable claims development on losses from prior periods. This release predominantly affected the Treaty, Energy, and Marine Divisions. The year 2018 was marked by significant catastrophe losses from US windstorms Michael and Florence, tropical typhoons Jebi and Trami in Asia, and wildfires in California, as well as losses from the Ituango hydroelectric dam in Colombia. Prior year events from 2017, including hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, Mexico earthquakes, and California wildfires, also contributed to the overall claims landscape.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2015 Year of Account, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development from the triangle itself. The prior year development figure is taken from a specific note.
